description: Instituto Nacional de Estatística: wildfire hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Nacional de Estatística. Coverage: Instituto Nacional de Estatística. The listing groups 9 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wildfire hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Proporção de superfície ardida (do incêndio rural ha); Incêndios rurais (N.º); Tempo despendido na prevenção de incêndios rurais (h). Formats seen: JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
